//: Capability manifest for <StackedBar> (the .pa-stacked-bar container) — svelte-pure-admin. See list.map.json / data-bar.map.json for the model. CONTAINER-ONLY slice: StackedBar.svelte is a <div class="pa-stacked-bar [--size] [--rounded] {class}"> wrapper with a `children` slot. The segments + legend are SEPARATE child components (StackedBarSegment / StackedBarLegend / StackedBarLegendItem) fed through the slot — the dumper can't materialize them (slot content arrives as plain text), so the __segment / __legend* element classes are the DEFERRED child-component sub-slice, not mapped here. size is sm|lg; rounded is the isRounded bool.
